title: DC-area forecast: Scattered showers and storms today with a flood watch this morning
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: We're in the 70s this morning with a flood watch covering much of the region until 11 a.m. The humidity is back today with scattered showers and storms, maybe a few flooding downpours, especially this morning into early afternoon.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: We're in the 70s this morning with a flood watch covering much of the region until 11 a.m. Humidity is back today with scattered showers and storms, maybe a few flooding downpours, especially this morning into perhaps early afternoon.

What’s next? Staying humid and turning hotter tomorrow through the weekend. Shower and storm chances continue, mainly during the afternoons into evenings.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: The heat holds back, but humidity makes a comeback, and we're dodging some showers and storms with a flood risk. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Wednesday): Mostly cloudy and very humid. We've got scattered showers and storms, with a few flooding downpours possible, this morning into early afternoon as a warm front lingers nearby. The heaviest storms could dump 2 inches or more of rain. We may see fewer showers and storms by mid- to late afternoon. Highs should reach the 80s with icky dew points in the low to mid-70s. A light breeze develops from the south this afternoon at about 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: A few scattered showers and a downpour are possible during the evening with lower rain chances overnight. Otherwise partly to mostly cloudy and staying super muggy with lows in the low to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Thursday): Partly sunny and hotter with highs heading for around 90 to 95. Continued high humidity (dew points still in low to mid-70s) helps the heat index peak in the upper 90s to near 100. The chance of scattered showers and storms is mainly during the afternoon into evening. With the higher heat, some could be strong to severe with localized flooding and damaging winds. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Scattered showers and strong to severe storms remain possible during the evening. Partly cloudy and muggy overnight with lower rain chances and lows in the 70s. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

The weather pattern is pretty much stuck Friday through Sunday. Highs should be in the upper 80s to mid-90s, and it's still quite humid with dew points mainly in the low 70s. Late-day isolated to scattered showers and storms are possible each day, although chances may be lower on Sunday. Muggy nighttime lows are around 70 to 75. Confidence: Low-Medium

Similar heat and humidity look to stick around Monday and Tuesday. A chance for showers and storms may linger as well, with Tuesday perhaps having the higher chance.

DC weather history for August 5

Blistering heat in 1930 pushed temperatures to 102 degrees amid a devastating drought, part of a summer that saw a record number of 100-degree days and severe agricultural losses.
